newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: ACT NZ's Prebble set to win Wellington seat - poll.
newsitem.headline: ACT NZ's Prebble set to win Wellington seat - poll.

text.p: Act New Zealand leader Richard Prebble leads the race for the key Wellington Central electorate, a TV1 poll on Wednesday said.
The poll of 500 voters showed Prebble up eight points to 30 percent, while National's Mark Thomas was unchanged on 25 percent and Labour's Alick Shaw was also on 25 percent, up two.
Act, a potential ally for National after Saturday's general election, must win at least one electorate seat or five percent of the party vote to get MPs into parliament.
Act has been hovering around the five percent threshold lately, but scored 6.4 percent in a TV3 poll separately released on Wednesday. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 473-4746
